concerns.text: The `estimation_result.schema.yaml` contract enumerates `outcome_model` values as `nonlinear_correct`, `quadratic`, `interaction_omitted`, but the specification, plan, and tasks (e.g., T005, T006, T007, T008) consistently use the identifier `quadratic_missing_sine`. This mismatch means the pipeline will fail schema validation for any result that uses the intended `quadratic_missing_sine` model, breaking coverage of FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑004, FR‑006 and SC‑001, SC‑003, SC‑005. Update the contract to include `quadratic_missing_sine` (or rename the model consistently) so that all tasks can satisfy the required schema.
